Brand Event on a Rainy Night

entries.source: 拍摄林晚宠粉的温暖瞬间（需确认 1 张）
entries.en: Capture Lin Wan's kindness to a fan (confirm 1 photo).

entries.source: 现场突降大雨，小北撑伞却被林晚嫌伞太小抢走。在林晚经过举牌粉丝旁时找准构图，拍出“把唯一的伞送给粉丝”的新闻图。
entries.en: Rain starts. Lin Wan snatches Xiao Bei's umbrella, calling it too small. Frame her beside the fan so it looks like she is giving away her only umbrella.

entries.source: 《雨中暖心举动！林晚把唯一的伞送给粉丝》
entries.en: Kindness in the Rain! Lin Wan Gives Her Only Umbrella to a Fan

entries.source: 拍摄 3 张现场照片并剪辑发布（需确认 3 张）
entries.en: Shoot and edit a report from the scene (confirm 3 photos).

entries.source: “我赶着上场，后台如果有乱七八糟的事，麻烦别发出去。”
entries.en: "I'm due on stage. If anything messy happens backstage, please keep it out of the news."

entries.en: Behind the Charity Show: Truth or Image?

entries.en: The desk has no usable photo. Take and confirm 1 shot first.

entries.source: 《雨中暖心举动!林晚把唯一的伞送给粉丝》
entries.en: Kindness in the Rain! Lin Wan Gives Her Only Umbrella to a Fan

entries.source: 昨夜品牌户外活动突发急雨，当红女星林晚被镜头捕捉到撑着唯一的雨伞走向举牌守候的粉丝身旁，温情画面迅速登上热搜头版。
entries.en: Rain struck last night's outdoor brand event. Cameras caught star Lin Wan approaching a waiting fan with the only umbrella. The touching image quickly made the front page.

entries.source: “姐姐雨这么大还优先照顾粉丝，路转粉了！”
entries.en: "She puts her fans first, even in that rain. I'm a fan now!"

entries.source: 团队：“完美的角度！公关危机直接变成年度暖心热搜！”
entries.en: Team: "Perfect angle! A PR crisis just became the year's most heartwarming story!"

entries.source: 小北（画外音）：“……没人看到我在后面淋透了吗？”
entries.en: Xiao Bei (off camera): "... Did nobody see me getting soaked behind her?"

entries.source: 《公关翻车：淋雨助理与抢伞同框曝光》
entries.en: PR Backfire: Soaked Assistant Exposes Umbrella Grab

entries.source: 《废稿退回：新闻主题说服力不足》
entries.en: Rejected: The Photo Does Not Support the Story

entries.source: 成片拍摄时机尚未形成“雨中靠近粉丝送伞”的错位视觉，报社无法按预设暖心稿件刊登。
entries.en: The timing fails to create the impression of Lin Wan giving her umbrella to the fan. The paper cannot run the planned feel-good story.

entries.source: 成片将淋雨发愣的助理小北一并拍进画框，评论区一眼看穿“唯一雨伞”另有隐情！
entries.en: The frame includes Xiao Bei, soaked and stunned. Readers immediately see there is more to the 'only umbrella' story!

entries.source: 画面缺少关键人物或应援牌特征，读者无法认出林晚与粉丝互动。
entries.en: A key person or the fan sign is missing. Readers cannot identify an interaction between Lin Wan and her fan.

entries.source: 网友：“后面那个浑身湿透的小北是谁？”
entries.en: Comment: "Who's that soaked Xiao Bei in the background?"

entries.source: 网友：“这拍的是什么，完全看不懂。”
entries.en: Comment: "What am I looking at? This makes no sense."

entries.source: 主编：“重拍！时间窗口要选林晚经过粉丝时，构图必须框住她、伞和粉丝且裁掉小北。”
entries.en: Editor: "Retake it. Shoot as she passes the fan. Include her, the umbrella and the fan; crop out Xiao Bei."

entries.source: 提示：使用 ←/→ 拖到 22–30s，滚轮放大或按住左键向右拖拽构图，按 Enter 重拍。
entries.en: Tip: Seek to 22-30s with Left/Right. Zoom in or drag right to reframe, then press Enter to shoot.

entries.source: 第{Collision + 1}张交代碰撞，第{Argument + 1}张保留争执，第{Pickup + 1}张拍到补救。
entries.en: Photo {0} shows the collision, {1} the argument and {2} the effort to put things right.
entries.pattern: ^第(.*?)张交代碰撞，第(.*?)张保留争执，第(.*?)张拍到补救。$

entries.source: 她碰倒了东西，后来也蹲下来帮忙。这段至少交代清楚了。
entries.en: She knocked things over, then helped pick them up. At least this tells the whole story.

entries.source: 事实完整，但失态也跟着公开了。
entries.en: The facts are complete, but her loss of composure is public too.

entries.source: 艺人：我希望你发布前先和我说一声。
entries.en: Star: I wish you'd told me before publishing.

entries.source: 第{Pickup + 1}张捡起物品，第{Handoff + 1}张交还，第{Together + 1}张两人同框。
entries.en: Photo {0} shows the pickup, {1} the handover and {2} both people together.
entries.pattern: ^第(.*?)张捡起物品，第(.*?)张交还，第(.*?)张两人同框。$

entries.source: 她还蹲下来帮忙捡，看起来挺照顾工作人员。
entries.en: She even knelt down to help. She seems considerate of the staff.

entries.source: 亲和力很自然。我们会用这条做活动回顾。
entries.en: The warmth looks natural. We'll use this in the event recap.

entries.source: 志愿者：前面东西为什么掉地上，你也拍到了吧？
entries.en: Volunteer: You also filmed why everything fell, didn't you?

entries.source: 第{Argument + 1}张出现争执，第{Scattered + 1}张接上散落物品，成片省略了补救。
entries.en: Photo {0} shows the argument, followed by scattered items in {1}. The report leaves out the help afterward.
entries.pattern: ^第(.*?)张出现争执，第(.*?)张接上散落物品，成片省略了补救。$

entries.source: 她刚指着人说话，下一秒就是东西散了一地，发生了什么？
entries.en: She's pointing at someone, then everything is on the floor. What happened?

entries.source: 合作方暂停了转发，想先了解事情经过。
entries.en: Our partner has paused sharing the post until they know what happened.

entries.source: 艺人：我后来帮忙收拾了，你为什么没发那段？
entries.en: Star: I helped clean up afterward. Why didn't you show that?

entries.source: 顺序或构图遗漏了把动作连起来的证据。
entries.en: The order or framing leaves out the evidence linking these actions.

entries.source: 看出了几个片段，可是它们之间发生了什么？
entries.en: I can see separate moments, but what happened between them?

entries.source: 下次把人物、动作和相关物件交代清楚。
entries.en: Next time, show the people, actions and relevant objects clearly.

entries.source: 志愿者：如果有人问，我可以告诉他们现场发生了什么。
entries.en: Volunteer: If anyone asks, I can tell them what happened.

entries.source: 林晚从左侧入画，走到办公桌前停住。
entries.en: Lin Wan enters from the left and stops at the desk.

entries.source: 第二轮回传动作已接入；5 FPS逐帧取样，道具按握点附着。
entries.en: Round 2 animations are active: 5 FPS sampling with props attached to grip points.

entries.source: 林晚用力敲桌。女主演员后退撞到桌沿，身体后仰、手撑桌面。
entries.en: Lin Wan slams the desk. The lead actress backs into it, leans back and braces herself on its surface.

entries.source: 林晚逼近一步。导演鼓掌；女主演员低头经过林晚，向左离开。
entries.en: Lin Wan steps closer. The director applauds; the actress lowers her head and exits left past Lin Wan.

entries.source: 林晚回头微笑。助理小周跑近；林晚扫一眼，抢过雨伞，小周愣住。
entries.en: Lin Wan turns and smiles. Assistant Xiao Zhou runs up; she glances over and snatches the umbrella, leaving Xiao Zhou stunned.

entries.source: 林晚拿着撑开的伞离去，身后等候的粉丝恰好进入镜头。
entries.en: Lin Wan leaves with the open umbrella. Fans waiting behind her happen to fall into the frame.

entries.source: 间幕 · 路灯下的照片
entries.en: Interlude / A Photo Under the Streetlight

entries.source: 小夏与男人站在路灯下；林晚从后方拿手机拍照。
entries.en: Xiao Xia and a man stand under a streetlight. Lin Wan takes a phone photo from behind them.

entries.source: 《扶摇直上》后台走廊，左侧是选手照片墙。
entries.en: The backstage corridor of Rise to Stardom. A contestant photo wall stands on the left.

entries.source: 林晚视线移到照片墙某处，伸手至眼前，用力扯下照片边缘的贴纸或旧标签。
entries.en: Lin Wan looks at one spot on the wall, raises her hand and tears a sticker or old label from a photo's edge.

entries.source: 小北从右侧小跑进入；林晚向前迈步。
entries.en: Xiao Bei jogs in from the right. Lin Wan steps forward.

entries.source: 林晚伸掌向前推。小北摔倒，资料散落。
entries.en: Lin Wan thrusts her palm forward. Xiao Bei falls and papers scatter.

entries.source: 小北没有抬头，撑着膝盖站起，再迅速蹲下。
entries.en: Without looking up, Xiao Bei pushes off her knees, stands and quickly crouches again.

entries.source: 小北迅速蹲下，收拾散落的材料。
entries.en: Xiao Bei crouches quickly to gather the scattered papers.

entries.source: 小北抱起资料站起，准备离开。
entries.en: Xiao Bei stands with the papers in her arms, ready to leave.

entries.source: 小北抱着资料短暂停留，情绪紧张。
entries.en: Xiao Bei pauses briefly with the papers, visibly tense.

entries.source: 小北向左快步离开。林晚向右走，唇边浮起冷笑。
entries.en: Xiao Bei hurries left. Lin Wan walks right, a cold smile forming on her lips.

entries.source: 苏瑶从右侧轻快走来，带着笑，停在林晚身边。
entries.en: Su Yao walks briskly in from the right, smiling, and stops beside Lin Wan.

entries.source: 林晚侧身迈步、蹬地。苏瑶失衡后倒，双膝跪坐，双手撑地。
entries.en: Lin Wan steps sideways and stamps her foot. Su Yao loses balance and falls back onto her knees, hands braced on the floor.

entries.source: 林晚低头看了一眼，没有立刻扶她；苏瑶跪坐在地。
entries.en: Lin Wan looks down without offering her hand. Su Yao remains kneeling on the floor.

entries.source: 苏瑶慢慢站起，整理裙摆，重新挂起甜笑。
entries.en: Su Yao slowly stands, straightens her skirt and puts her sweet smile back on.

entries.source: 林晚赶到舞台中央，停步抬头，面对镜头挤出笑容；下台后，她将经过杂物间。
entries.en: Lin Wan hurries to center stage, stops, looks up and forces a smile for the cameras. After leaving the stage, she will pass the storage room.

entries.source: 林晚下台经过安全通道，停在杂物间门旁，贴近门缝侧耳倾听。
entries.en: After leaving the stage, Lin Wan stops by a storeroom off the emergency exit corridor and listens at the door.

entries.source: 门后：李谋低声安抚苏瑶；苏瑶愤怒提及小北；李谋再次提到小北。
entries.en: Behind the door, Li Mou quietly soothes Su Yao. She angrily mentions Xiao Bei; Li Mou brings her up again.

entries.source: 林晚僵在门后，背靠墙，缓缓攥紧拳头。
entries.en: Lin Wan freezes by the door, leans against the wall and slowly clenches her fists.
Before the Final / The Dressing Mirror

entries.source: 林晚背对门坐在镜前，陈默轻敲两下门，从左侧进入。
entries.en: Lin Wan sits at the mirror with her back to the door. Chen Mo knocks twice and enters from the left.

entries.source: 陈默停在两步之外，示意赞许。林晚回头，怀疑、动摇。
entries.en: Chen Mo stops two steps away and gestures his approval. Lin Wan turns, suspicious and wavering.

entries.source: 陈默后退一步，转身离开，在门口稍作停顿。
entries.en: Chen Mo steps back, turns to leave and pauses at the doorway.

entries.source: 苏瑶推门进入，靠近林晚，笑容收敛，前倾压低声音。
entries.en: Su Yao enters, approaches Lin Wan and drops her smile. She leans forward and lowers her voice.
A White Rose and a Prop Knife

entries.source: 林晚站起直视苏瑶；工作人员递上白玫瑰和道具刀。
entries.en: Lin Wan stands and meets Su Yao's eyes. A crew member hands over a white rose and a prop knife.

entries.source: 舞台强光。林晚握紧道具刀，压低重心，向前半步。
entries.en: Under the harsh stage lights, Lin Wan grips the prop knife, lowers her stance and steps half a pace forward.

entries.source: 苏瑶抢先尖叫，后倒、捂肩跪地，抬头指向林晚。
entries.en: Su Yao screams first, falls back and kneels, clutching her shoulder. She looks up and points at Lin Wan.

entries.source: 导播要求切广告，主持人宣布取消林晚资格；工作人员冲上台拖走林晚。
entries.en: The director calls for a commercial break. The host disqualifies Lin Wan, and crew rush onstage to drag her away.

entries.source: 林晚站在路灯下，陈默从左侧走来，将文件递给她。
entries.en: Lin Wan waits under the streetlight. Chen Mo approaches from the left and hands her a file.

entries.source: 林晚面对手机镜头，深呼吸，说出五年前的真相。
entries.en: Facing her phone camera, Lin Wan takes a deep breath and reveals the truth about five years ago.

entries.source: 陈默进入画面。将证据卡拖入直播窗口，再按发送。
entries.en: Chen Mo enters the frame. Drag the evidence card into the livestream window, then press Send.

entries.source: 小北从右侧走来，选择勇敢站出来。继续发送证据。
entries.en: Xiao Bei enters from the right and finds the courage to speak up. Keep sending the evidence.

entries.source: 剧组龙套从右侧走入画面。发送最后一份证据。
entries.en: A background actor enters from the right. Send the final piece of evidence.

entries.source: 李谋被警方带走；苏瑶被行业封杀；《扶摇直上》换导重拍。
entries.en: Police take Li Mou away. Su Yao is blacklisted, and Rise to Stardom is reshot with a new director.

entries.source: 数周后，新片场的户外入口。林晚等在路边，小北拿着雨伞走来。
entries.en: Weeks later, outside the new film set. Lin Wan waits by the road as Xiao Bei approaches with an umbrella.

entries.source: 林晚抢过雨伞，走出画面。
entries.en: Lin Wan snatches the umbrella and walks out of frame.

entries.source: 拍摄三张照片，帮助客户沉冤昭雪。
entries.en: Take three photos to help clear your client's name.

entries.source:
“我拿走了助理给我带的伞，却不知道哪里来的小人说我苛待他人。
大师，您可要帮我伸张正义呀！”
entries.en: “I took the umbrella my assistant brought me, and some petty gossip turned that into me mistreating people. Master, you have to get me justice!”

entries.source: 一场戏、一次抢伞，还有路灯下的一张照片。
entries.en: A scene, a snatched umbrella and a photo under a streetlight.

entries.source: 片场内外：林晚的一天被镜头记录
entries.en: On Set and Off: A Day in Lin Wan's Life

entries.source: 掌声之后，聚光灯外还有另一面
entries.en: After the Applause: Beyond the Spotlight

entries.source: 强势姿态走出片场，雨夜举动引关注
entries.en: From On-Set Pressure to Rainy-Night Controversy

entries.source: 从片场的对峙到雨中的离去，三个时刻组成了这一期报道。
entries.en: From the confrontation on set to the departure in the rain, three moments make up this edition.

entries.source: 照片能够记录动作，前后顺序与构图则决定读者看见怎样的故事。
entries.en: Photos record actions. Their order and framing shape the story readers see.

entries.source:
“我当时赶着上场，不明白为什么就被人指责成业内霸凌了。
大师，您可要帮我伸张正义呀！”
entries.en: “I was rushing to get onstage. How did that turn into people calling me a bully? Master, you have to get me justice!”

entries.source: 照片墙、散落的资料、重新挂起的甜笑。
entries.en: A photo wall, scattered papers and a sweet smile restored.

entries.source: 真人秀后台：三张照片还原现场片段
entries.en: Reality Show Backstage: Three Photos from the Scene

entries.source: 冲突之外，谁的处境值得被看见
entries.en: Beyond the Conflict: Who Deserves to Be Seen?

entries.source: 甜笑背后，后台风波引发质疑
entries.en: Behind the Sweet Smile: Backstage Trouble Raises Questions

entries.source: 照片墙前的动作、走廊中的失衡与紧闭的门，构成了本关的现场。
entries.en: An action at the photo wall, a fall in the corridor and a closed door define this level's events.

entries.source: 本报刊登玩家选择的三个时刻；未进入取景框的细节并未因此消失。
entries.en: We print the three moments you choose. Details outside the frame have not ceased to exist.

entries.source: 拍摄三张照片，帮助客户打败绿茶对家。
entries.en: Take three photos to help your client outplay her two-faced rival.

entries.source:
“遇到比我还茶的恶女演员，真是佩服！
我赞叹她无外力作用下展现的虚空恐惧。大师，您可要帮我伸张正义呀！”
entries.en: “An actress who's even faker than I am? I'm impressed! No one even touched her, and you'd think she was fighting for her life. Master, you have to get me justice!”

entries.source: 化妆间的交锋，舞台上的尖叫与一份文件。
entries.en: A dressing-room confrontation, a scream on stage and a file.

entries.source: 决赛风波：镜头记录舞台内外
entries.en: Finals Controversy: On Stage and Off

entries.source: 带离舞台之后，事件仍有待追问
entries.en: Removed from the Stage, but Questions Remain

entries.source: 尖叫与取消资格，决赛现场陷入争议
entries.en: Scream and Disqualification Plunge the Final into Controversy

entries.source: 道具交接、舞台上的骤变以及离场后的会面，被整理为本期图文。
entries.en: The prop handover, the sudden turn on stage and the later meeting form this edition's photo report.

entries.source: 单张照片无法呈现全部经过。拍摄时刻、裁切和排序共同影响阅读。
entries.en: No single photo shows the entire event. Timing, cropping and order all influence how it is read.

entries.source: 向直播间发送全部三份证据，帮客户沉冤昭雪。再选三张现场照片发布报道。
entries.en: Send all three pieces of evidence to the livestream to clear your client's name. Then choose three photos and publish your report.

entries.source: “那些证据，现在就是出示的时候！老熟人，你不会背叛我的吧？”
entries.en: “Now's the time to show them the evidence! After all we've been through, you won't turn on me now, will you?”

entries.source: 三份证据进入直播，事件之后仍有新的镜头。
entries.en: Three pieces of evidence go live. Afterward, the camera keeps watching.

entries.source: 真相直播：三份证据与三个现场时刻
entries.en: Truth on Livestream: Three Pieces of Evidence, Three Moments

entries.source: 勇敢开口之后，镜头继续记录
entries.en: After Speaking Out, the Camera Keeps Rolling

entries.source: 风波落幕，新的片场又现熟悉一幕
entries.en: The Scandal Ends. A Familiar Moment at a New Set.

entries.source: 三份证据已经送入直播；李谋、苏瑶和剧组的后续也进入了公众视野。
entries.en: All three pieces of evidence are live. The aftermath for Li Mou, Su Yao and the crew is now public.

entries.source: 报道由本关实拍照片组成。最后一次雨伞交接，为故事留下新的观察角度。
entries.en: This report uses photos taken in this level. The final umbrella handover offers another angle on the story.
The director drinking with Su Yao

entries.source: 名单上除了苏瑶都被打 X
entries.en: Every contestant except Su Yao is crossed out
